name: The Hundred
description: The classic Pilates warm-up: head and shoulders curled up, legs raised, pump your straight arms up and down in small beats while you breathe.

source.note: Classic Pilates mat exercise, described in our own words for this library. Stick-figure approximation.

setup: Lie on your back and draw your knees in.
Curl your head and shoulders off the mat and extend your legs to about 45°.
Reach your arms long by your hips, just off the mat.
cues: Breathe in for 5 pumps and out for 5; ten breaths makes 100.
Keep your lower back on the mat; raise your legs higher if it lifts.
Easier: keep your knees bent over your hips.

prescription.note: Move with your breath, slowly and with control.
